description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named HelloController, which provides basic endpoints for welcoming, health check, documentation redirect, and application info, with annotations for Swagger/OpenAPI documentation.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: Spring Boot REST controller providing basic endpoints for welcome message, API documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a simple welcome message indicating the Start of the Spring Boot application.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Constructs a redirect URL to Swagger UI, preserving the original request's scheme, host, and port, and redirects the client accordingly.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns the string 'OK' indicating the application's health status.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns basic application information as a string.
